newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR WEAKER ON IMPORT PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Wednesday's interbank session easier on hard units on the back of import pressure, forex dealers said.
"There was some (foreign currency) buying especially around mid session and towards the close of business and we also saw the central bank buying," one trader commented.
The local currency finished the day at 11.3775/3875 against the U.S. dollar, depreciating from Tuesday's 11.3700/3800 and was also weaker at 19.0455/1150 versus sterling compared to 18.9600/9900.
It was at 6.3485/3650 from 6.3200/3400 against the mark and at 2.4975/5075 to the rand from 2.4900/5100.
